Seky Barcode bundles the following browser libraries for offline use:

JsBarcode 3.11.6
Project: https://github.com/lindell/JsBarcode
License: MIT
License text: JsBarcode-LICENSE.txt

SheetJS Community Edition (xlsx) 0.18.5
Project: https://github.com/SheetJS/sheetjs
License: Apache License 2.0
License text: SheetJS-LICENSE.txt

These libraries are used by the app's barcode and Excel export features.
